garbled: explanatory text merged into stem

patterns: APPSC asks this topic as one-liners: 'which is not a fossil fuel / not renewable' (solar, natural gas, uranium traps), petroleum products, biggest thermal plant (Vindhyachal), AP's largest thermal station.

Other PSCs heavily test place->state matching: coalfields (Jharia, Talcher, Makum, Singareni), refineries (Tatipaka-AP/ONGC, Noonmati, Koyali, Barauni), power stations and nuclear plants, plus firsts (Raniganj 1774, Makum oil well, Digboi, Tarapur 1969).

Recurring traps: largest lignite = Tamil Nadu not Jharkhand; first oil well Makum vs first commercial Digboi; Barauni in Bihar; Ramagundam now Telangana; Kovvada (US), Kudankulam (Russia), Jaitapur (France).
App MCQs over-index on 2025-26 capacity statistics, policy details (SHAKTI windows, Budget duty) and AP project investments that PYQs never ask; PYQs prefer stable location facts.
